تستفهمون (form X)
# تَسْتَفْهِمُونَ (tastafhimūna) /tas.taf.hi.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَفْهَمَ (istafhama)
# تُسْتَفْهَمُونَ (tustafhamūna) /tus.taf.ha.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَفْهَمَ (istafhama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
